user.title: petWALK door
user.description: Enable the REST API first: petWALK app → your door → Advanced settings → REST API. After a firmware update it may have to be enabled again.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the door, as shown in the petWALK app next to the REST API setting.
data_description.port: Port of the local API. Only change it if you know the door uses another one.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the door.

error.cannot_connect: The door did not answer. Check the address and that the REST API is enabled in the petWALK app.
error.invalid_auth: The door rejected the request. This firmware may require authentication, which this integration does not support yet.
error.invalid_response: The door answered, but not as the petWALK local API documents. Please open an issue with your firmware version.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This door is already set up.
